limits: Local reconstruction, not an Adobe export.
Original raster shading becomes quantized flat color paths. The Rive-import SVG also simplifies the architectural backplanes; the detailed master preserves their traced appearance.
Only source-visible surfaces can be recovered; hidden surfaces are approximated.
Native Rive import, animation export and runtime playback not tested.
Preferred original mascot is a separate, not-included rig.
Furniture groups are not 3D objects; full rotations and large moves require redraws.
Display text such as OPERATIONAL is decorative reference artwork, not live monitoring.
